description: Azure capabilities the factory can currently build. M2 (Plan) may ONLY use these types; M3 (Generate) maps each to Terraform.

capabilities.description: Container for every resource in the demo instance; deleting it tears down the whole demo.

capabilities.use_when: Whenever a container_app is present, or the user asks for monitoring.

capabilities.description: Relational database for structured payer data.
capabilities.use_when: Member, provider, claims, and authorization data.

capabilities.description: Serverless document database for semi-structured data.
capabilities.use_when: Care management plans, notes, and care-team timelines.

capabilities.description: Serverless container hosting for the demo backend API.
capabilities.use_when: The demo needs an API or backend service.

capabilities.description: Hosting for the demo's browser UI.
capabilities.use_when: The demo needs a web UI or dashboard.

capabilities.description: Blob storage for documents, exports, and static assets.
capabilities.use_when: The demo needs file/document storage (e.g., prior-auth attachments).
